newsitem.title: INDIA: Laloo Yadav to appeal against bail rejection - PTI.
newsitem.headline: Laloo Yadav to appeal against bail rejection - PTI.

text.p: Bihar Chief Minister Laloo Prasad Yadav will move the Supreme Court against the Patna High Court's order on Thursday rejecting his plea for anticipatory bail in a corruption case, his lawyer said.
"We will challenge the high court's order in the apex (Supreme) court soon," Shashi Anugraha Narayan was quoted by the Press Trust of India (PTI) as saying.

Earlier on Thursday, Judge Daljit Singh Dhaliwal rejected an appeal by Yadav seeking legal protection against his arrest by federal police in the $280-million corruption scandal involving the alleged embezzlement of animal welfare funds.
Yadav says he is innocent in the case and sought "anticipatory bail" allowed under Indian law to avert possible arrest.

Yadav, who earlier this month formed a breakaway group of Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's Janata Dal party, has refused to resign after the Central Bureau of Investigation indicted him in the corruption case.
Yadav's stand has sharply divided parties in Gujral's 15-party United Front alliance over whether or not to admit his faction, the Rashtriya Janata Dal.
Gujral's coalition has been rattled because Yadav is a powerful low-caste leader with mass support in his state but is seen hurting the alliance's image nationally.
